WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT m.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member AS mb
    JOIN major AS m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major
    GROUP BY m.department
), department_shares AS (
    SELECT department,
           member_count,
           1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM department_counts
), scored AS (
    SELECT department,
           member_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM department_shares
)
SELECT department,
       member_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Departments represented by at least one member whose major matches a row in major are the departments included in the average; members with no matching major are excluded, as specified.
